comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3
comments.comment:
e6
transposes into 3... e6 4. e3 a6
Against ...Bg4, f3; then h4 against ...Bh5 and g4 against ...Bf5: (4... Bg4 5. f3 Bh5 6. h4) (4... Bg4 5. f3 Bf5 6. g4)
Against ...b5 or ...g6, h4: (4... b5 5. h4) (4... g6 5. h4)
Against ...h6, Nf3: (4... h6 5. Nf3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3
comments.comment: Against ...Nbd7, Ne5 as usual: (5... Nbd7 6. Ne5)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5
comments.comment: Against the rest, g4 as well, and h4 once the bishop drops to g6: (6... Bb4 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4) (6... h6 7. g4) (6... Be7 7. g4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 Nbd7 7. g4
comments.comment: Against ...Be4, f3 drives the bishop to g6, then h4: (7... Be4 8. f3 Bg6 9. h4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 Nbd7 7. g4 Nxe5 8. gxf5
comments.comment:
Take the bishop first. After dxe5, the f6-knight takes on g4, and the f5-bishop is safe. Now the e5-knight is attacked by the d-pawn and the f4-bishop and has to move.
(8... Nc6 9. Bd3) (8... Ned7 9. fxe6) (8... Nc4 9. Bxc4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 Nbd7 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4 h5 9. Nxg6 fxg6 10. g5
comments.comment: Against ...Ne4, Qd3 hits the knight a second time: (10... Ne4 11. Qd3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 Nbd7 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4 h5 9. Nxg6 fxg6 10. g5 Ng8 11. Bh3
comments.comment:
Bh3 hits the e6-pawn.
(11... Kf7 12. Qf3) (11... Qe7 12. e4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 Bd6 7. g4
comments.comment:
Against ...Bxe5, dxe5: the f6-knight and the f5-bishop are both attacked. Against ...Be4, f3 and h4.
(7... Bxe5 8. dxe5) (7... Be4 8. f3 Bg6 9. h4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 Bd6 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4
comments.comment: Against ...h6, take on g6 all the same; against ...Bxe5, dxe5: (8... h6 9. Nxg6) (8... Bxe5 9. dxe5)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 Bd6 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4 h5 9. Nxg6
comments.comment: After ...fxg6, g5 drives the knight back, as against ...Nbd7: (9... fxg6 10. g5)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 c5 7. g4
comments.comment: Against ...Be4, f3: (7... Be4 8. f3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 c5 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4
comments.comment: Against ...h6, take on g6 all the same; against ...cxd4, take back with the e-pawn: (8... h6 9. Nxg6) (8... cxd4 9. exd4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 c5 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4 h5 9. Nxg6 fxg6 10. g5
comments.comment: Against ...Ng8, Bh3 hits e6, as against ...Nbd7: (10... Ng8 11. Bh3) (10... Ne4 11. Nxe4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 e6 6. Ne5 c5 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4 h5 9. Nxg6 fxg6 10. g5 Nfd7 11. Bd3 Kf7 12. Qf3
comments.comment: Against ...Kg8, Bxg6 wins a pawn: (12... Kg8 13. Bxg6)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. Ne5
comments.comment:
Against ...e6, g4 and h4 as usual: (6... e6 7. g4 Bg6 8. h4)
Against ...Nb4, which hits c2, Rc1 guards it and keeps the light bishop: (6... Nb4 7. Rc1)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. Ne5 Nxe5 7. dxe5
comments.comment:
dxe5 hits the f6-knight. After ...Nd7, nothing guards d5 any more.
(7... Ne4 8. Nxe4) (7... Nd7 8. Qxd5)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 h6 6. Bd3
comments.comment: Against ...Ne4, take the knight; against ...Bg4, h3: (6... Ne4 7. Bxe4) (6... Bg4 7. h3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Bf5 5. Nf3 h6 6. Bd3 Bxd3 7. cxd3
comments.comment: Qb3 hits b7 and d5: (7... e6 8. Qb3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5
comments.comment: Against ...Qa5, which pins the c3-knight, Nf3: (5... Qa5 6. Nf3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5 e6 6. Na4
comments.comment:
Na4 guards the c5-pawn. After ...Bxc5 Nxc5 Qa5+ c3 Qxc5, Black has the pawn back, but we have the bishop pair. Against ...Nbd7, b4 holds the pawn; against ...Qa5+, c3.
(6... Bxc5 7. Nxc5 Qa5+ 8. c3 Qxc5 9. Nf3) (6... Nbd7 7. b4) (6... Qa5+ 7. c3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5 Nc6 6. a3 e5 7. Bg5 Bxc5 8. Bxf6
comments.comment: Bxf6 removes a guard of the d5-pawn, and Qxd5 wins it. The same against ...Qxf6: (8... Qxf6 9. Qxd5)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5 Nc6 6. a3 e5 7. Bg5 Bxc5 8. Bxf6 gxf6 9. Qxd5
comments.comment:
After the queen trade, take back with the knight.
(9... Qe7 10. Ne4) (9... Qb6 10. O-O-O)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5 Nc6 6. a3 e5 7. Bg5 Be6 8. b4
comments.comment:
b4 holds the c5-pawn. Against ...h6, take on f6 at once: Bh4 runs into ...g5.
(8... h6 9. Bxf6) (8... d4 9. exd4) (8... a5 9. Nf3)

1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5 Nc6 6. a3 e5 7. Bg5 Be6 8. b4 Be7 9. Be2 O-O 10. Nf3
comments.comment: Against ...d4, Bxf6 and Ne4, as after ...h6: (10... d4 11. Bxf6 Bxf6 12. Ne4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5 Nc6 6. a3 e5 7. Bg5 d4 8. Na4 Qa5+ 9. c3
1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 c5 5. dxc5 Nc6 6. a3 e5 7. Bg5 d4 8. Na4 Qa5+ 9. c3 dxc3 10. b4
comments.comment:
b4 hits the queen. Against ...Qc7, Nb6 hits the a8-rook.
(10... Nxb4 11. axb4 Qxb4 12. Qc2) (10... Qc7 11. Nb6)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Nc6 5. Bd3
comments.comment:
Against ...h6, a3 keeps the knight out of b4, where it would hit the d3-bishop: (5... h6 6. a3)
Against ...g6, Nf3: (5... g6 6. Nf3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Nc6 5. Bd3 e6 6. Nf3
comments.comment: Against ...Bb4, castle; against ...h6 and ...Be7, a3: (6... Bb4 7. O-O) (6... h6 7. a3) (6... Be7 7. a3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Nc6 5. Bd3 e6 6. Nf3 Bd6 7. Ne5
comments.comment:
Against ...O-O, h4 starts the attack; against ...Bxe5, dxe5 hits the f6-knight.
(7... O-O 8. h4) (7... Bxe5 8. dxe5)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Nc6 5. Bd3 Bg4 6. f3
comments.comment: Against ...Bd7, Nge2: (6... Bd7 7. Nge2)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Nc6 5. Bd3 Bg4 6. f3 Bh5 7. h4
comments.comment:
Against ...h6, g4 and Bxg6; after ...fxg6, Qd3 hits g6: (7... h6 8. g4 Bg6 9. Bxg6 fxg6 10. Qd3)
Against ...e6, g4: (7... e6 8. g4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 a6 4. e3 Nc6 5. Bd3 Bg4 6. f3 Bh5 7. h4 Bg6 8. g4
comments.comment:
After ...Bxd3, take back with the queen.
(8... h6 9. Bxg6 fxg6 10. Qd3) (8... h5 9. Bxg6) (8... e6 9. a3)
